item.case_name: Full product spot, 30 s, 9:16, two references
item.title: Mockup Fragrance product spot

turns.text:
Make a 30-second vertical 9:16 ad for my perfume, Mockup Fragrance. Use the attached bottle photo and the attached photo of our presenter. Keep the bottle's shape, colour and label the same in every shot, and leave the box out. Keep the presenter's face, hair and clothes the same in every shot.

Four shots, in this order:
1. The bottle alone on a light surface in soft sunlight, with a slow camera move.
2. The presenter holds up the bottle and looks at it.
3. The presenter sprays the perfume on her wrist.
4. End card for the last 4 seconds: solid #3B1F6B background, white text "MOCKUP FRAGRANCE" and "Available 12 December".

Use an off-camera voice-over with these exact words: "Some scents fade by noon. This one stays. It starts soft, like morning light on a wall, and it grows warmer as the day goes on. One spray on the wrist is enough. Mockup Fragrance. Available 12 December."

Show captions that match the voice-over. Put soft music under the voice. Give me one finished video file.

item.tests: Tests two references, four ordered shots, voice-over, captions, music mix, exact end card and one joined 30-second file.

answer_sheet.Bottle: The clear glass bottle with the grey cap and the MOCKUP FRAGRANCE label in the attached photo; leave the box out.
answer_sheet.Presenter: The woman in the attached photo; keep her face, hair and charcoal blazer.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 30-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Shots: Bottle alone; presenter holds up the bottle; presenter sprays her wrist; end card for the last 4 seconds.
answer_sheet.End card: Solid #3B1F6B background, white text MOCKUP FRAGRANCE and Available 12 December.
answer_sheet.Voice-over: Off-camera, exact words: Some scents fade by noon. This one stays. It starts soft, like morning light on a wall, and it grows warmer as the day goes on. One spray on the wrist is enough. Mockup Fragrance. Available 12 December.

must_haves: One playable 9:16 video file runs for 30 seconds, plus or minus 1 second.
Four shots appear in the requested order.
The bottle keeps its shape and colour across shots, the MOCKUP FRAGRANCE label stays readable, and the box does not appear.
The presenter keeps the same face, hair and clothes in shots 2 and 3.
The presenter holds up the same bottle in shot 2 and sprays her wrist with it in shot 3.
The last 4 seconds show the end card with the exact text on a solid background near #3B1F6B.
The voice-over speaks the exact words.
Soft music is audible under the voice.
No black frames at the cuts and a steady audio level.
